test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the following sentence.

If you do hard work, you will have the __expected results. __
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**desired results**" means the outcomes or results that one wants or wishes for.
 
• In the context of hard work, the results that one aims to achieve are typically the **"desired results."**
 
• The other options: "**required results**," "**good results**," and "**bad results**" do not appropriately convey the connotation of having goals or aspirations.

Therefore, the correct statement is: ***If you do hard work, you will have the desired results__.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Required results**: This implies results that are necessary, but not necessarily what one hopes for or desires.
 
• **Good results**: This is a general positive outcome but does not specify that it is what one aims for.
 
• **Bad results**: This is a negative outcome and opposite of what one would want from hard work.
